people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,
translations.bsb: They also took the livestock and possessions they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt.
translations.kjv: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed
translations.asv: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
